initialBackgroundLaunch.outcome: failed before any build or app launch
initialBackgroundLaunch.reason: Background Bash began in /Users/suas; the relative runner path did not exist there.

correctedBackgroundLaunch.method: Absolute runner path; runner changes working directory to its own assigned worktree. Results are recorded by each child command, not inferred from background acceptance.

remoteDiagnostic.outcome: finished; raw JSON downloaded and inspected; instance terminated
remoteDiagnostic.scope: Read-only git refs, selected updater/supervisor log lines, launcher matching lines, scheduled-task status and failed-marker presence. No remote runtime was installed or created. The small JSON receipt remains on the worker.
